description: This class defines a custom data type for handling Location objects within the OpenMRS system, providing serialization and deserialization capabilities based on location UUIDs.

classes.name: LocationDatatype
classes.description: Custom data type class for Location, extending BaseMetadataDatatype to handle Location objects with serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts a UUID string into a Location object by using the LocationService; returns null if the input is blank.
